status.title: Not public: {status}
status.staffNote: Staff preview — visitors cannot see this page.

text.DRAFT: Only you can see this preview. Finish the steps and publish it when you are ready.
text.IN_REVIEW: Our team is checking this listing. It goes live as soon as it is approved.
text.NEEDS_CHANGES: A moderator asked for changes. Edit the listing and send it again.
text.PAUSED: The listing is paused. Turn it back on to show it to guests again.
text.EXPIRED: The listing expired. Renew it to show it again.
text.RENTED: The listing is marked as rented, so guests no longer see it.
text.SOLD: The listing is marked as sold, so visitors no longer see it.
text.REJECTED: This listing was rejected and is not shown to visitors.
text.HIDDEN: Several people reported this listing. It stays hidden until a moderator checks it.
text.EXPIRED_DATE: The listing passed its expiry date. Renew it to show it again.
text.DEMO_HIDDEN: This is demo content, and demo data is switched off for visitors.
text.OWNER_INACTIVE: The owner's account is suspended, so the listing is not shown.
